errors.too_short: This is too short. Please write a little more.
errors.too_long: This is too long. Please write less.
errors.date_invalid: Enter a real date, for example 15 Meskerem 2010.
errors.unknown_question: Something went wrong with this question. Please go back and try again.
errors.answer_conflict: This answer was changed on your other device.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.payload_too_large: The recording is too long. Please say a shorter answer.
errors.unsupported_audio: We couldn't use that recording. Please try again.
errors.speech_unavailable: We couldn't turn your voice into text right now. Your recording is saved. You can type instead.
errors.resume_check_failed: That didn't match. Please check and try again.
errors.resume_expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Your answers are saved.
errors.not_implemented: This part is not ready yet.
errors.network: You seem to be offline. Your answers are saved on this phone.
signup.welcome.title: Sign up to learn with us
signup.welcome.hint: We will ask one question at a time. You can stop and come back. Your answers are saved as you go. You don't need any documents to start.
signup.consent_data.title: How we use your answers
signup.consent_data.hint: We keep your answers to set up your learning account. We don't ask about health or disability. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.
signup.full_name.title: What is your full name?
signup.full_name.hint: Write it the way you like it written.
signup.preferred_name.title: What should we call you?
signup.preferred_name.hint: For example a short name. You can skip this.
signup.contact_method.title: How can we reach you?
signup.contact_method.partner: Through an organisation that helps me
signup.contact_method.none: I don't want to be contacted
signup.phone.title: What is your phone number?
signup.dob.title: When were you born?
signup.dob.hint: For example 15 Meskerem 2010. You can skip this.
signup.id_route.title: Which of these do you have?
signup.id_route.hint: You can still sign up if you have none of these.
signup.id_route.none: I have none of these. Refer me through an organisation.
signup.id_doc_type.title: Which document do you have?
signup.id_last4.title: What are the last 4 numbers on it?
signup.id_last4.hint: For example 4821. You can skip this.
signup.referral_partner.title: Which organisation can help you?
signup.referral_partner.hint: They will contact you and help you finish signing up.
signup.referral_contact.title: How should they contact you?
signup.support_needs.title: What would help you?
signup.support_needs.hint: Choose any that help you learn or work. You don't need to explain why. You can skip this.
signup.support_other.title: Is there anything else that would help?
signup.support_other.hint: Say it or type it. You can skip this.
signup.support_share.title: Who can see what would help you?
signup.support_share.hint: Our support team can always see it. Choose who else can.
signup.support_share.employers: Employers when I apply for a job
signup.check.title: Check your answers
signup.done.title: You are signed up
signup.done.hint: We will contact you about what happens next.

needs.sign_language.employer: Sign language interpreter for interviews and meetings
needs.captions.learner: I need captions or written notes
needs.captions.employer: Captions and written notes for meetings
needs.flexible_hours.learner: I need flexible hours or breaks
needs.remote_work.learner: I need to work or study from home
needs.extra_time.learner: I need extra time for tests and tasks
needs.extra_time.employer: Extra time for tests and tasks
needs.written_instructions.learner: I need instructions in writing, in simple words
needs.quiet_space.learner: I need a quiet place to work
needs.own_device.learner: I need to use my own device or software
needs.own_device.employer: You may use your own assistive device or software
needs.person_to_help.learner: I need a person to help me
needs.person_to_help.employer: A named support person or mentor

application.start_date.title: When can you start?

employer.location_text.title: Which town or city?

employer.employment_type.title: What kind of job is it?
